summary: Registers image/t38 as a MIME media type for real-time fax. The encoding itself is defined by ITU-T T.38 and is intended for use as an SDP media descriptor.

eli5.summary: Faxes can now be sent over internet calls. This document registers the official label for that kind of fax data so programs know what it is.

questions: what is the image/t38 mime type
how is t38 fax described in sdp
